tasks.title: Lecture #36
tasks.instruction: Listen to a talk in a literature class.
tasks.transcript:
Woman: A common theme in literature is isolation, and that's what we'll explore today. Isolation can be a powerful motif reflecting the psychological effects of being separatedfrom society.
One of the most classic examples of isolation in literature is Mary Shelley's Frankenstein.In this novel Victor Frankenstein's grotesque creation, the creature experiences profound isolation due to his monstrous appearance and the fear he instills in people. This isolation leads to anger and a desire for revenge, thus highlighting the detrimental effects of being ostracized.
Another notable example is The Catcher in the Ride by JD Salinger. The protagonist Holden Caulfield feels disconnected from the world around him, and he struggles with alienation and loneliness. This social isolation is what drives Holden's actions and internal conflicts throughout the book.
Yet another example of isolation in literature, and one that ends badly, is Herman Melville's Moby Dick. In this novel Captain Ahab's obsessive, vengeful quest for the white whale leads to his isolation. This obsession distances him from his crew as dwell as his humanity, and it propels him and his ship toward a destructive end.
However, the portrayal of isolation in literature is not always negative. In Charlotte Bronte's Jane Eyre, the titular character experiences isolation at various points in her life, such as when she is sent to live with her unkind relatives, and later when she experiences loneliness at a boarding school. But Jane is resilient in the face of isolation, becoming strong and independent.

questions.stem: What aspect of isolation in literature does the speaker mainly discuss?

options.A: How it impacts society at large
options.B: How it is represented through characters in novels
options.C: How it impacts readers perceptions of a work
options.D: Why it appears so frequently throughout different works

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：演讲者主要讨论了文学中孤立的哪个方面？ 定位原文：Woman: A common theme in literature is isolation... One of the most classic examples... is Mary Shelley's Frankenstein... Another notable example is The Catcher in the Rye... 选项分析： A. How it impacts society at large 它如何影响整个社会。因为演讲重点在于小说中的人物如何体验孤立，而非对社会的影响，所以 A 选项错误。 B. How it is represented through characters in novels 它如何在小说人物中体现。由于演讲者列举了多部小说中的主角（弗兰肯斯坦的怪物、霍尔顿、亚哈船长、简·爱）来展示孤立这一主题，所以 B 选项正确。 C. How it impacts readers perceptions of a work 它如何影响读者对作品的看法。因为演讲未提及读者的感知，所以 C 选项错误。 D. Why it appears so frequently throughout different works 为什么它频繁出现在不同的作品中。因为演讲主要是在举例说明孤立的表现形式，而非分析其频繁出现的原因，所以 D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the speaker say about the creature in Frankenstein?

options.A: He finds solace only in nature.
options.B: He is considered a tragic figure in literature.
options.C: He is an outcast because of his appearance.
options.D: He is a common subject in studies of isolation in literature.

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：关于《弗兰肯斯坦》中的怪物，演讲者说了什么？ 定位原文：Woman: ...the creature experiences profound isolation due to his monstrous appearance and the fear he instills in people. 选项分析： A. He finds solace only in nature. 他只在大自然中寻找慰藉。因为演讲中未提及这一点，所以 A 选项错误。 B. He is considered a tragic figure in literature. 他被认为是文学中的悲剧人物。虽然这可能是事实，但演讲者强调的是他因外貌而被孤立，所以 B 选项不是演讲重点。 C. He is an outcast because of his appearance. 他因为外貌而被排斥。由于演讲明确指出怪物因为其可怕的外貌和引起的恐惧而经历深刻的孤立，所以 C 选项正确。 D. He is a common subject in studies of isolation in literature. 他是文学孤立研究的常见主题。因为演讲只将其作为一个例子，未提及学术研究的频率，所以 D 选项错误。

questions.stem: Why does the speaker mention Moby Dick?

options.A: To illustrate how isolation can have tragic consequences in literature
options.B: To contrast different literary perspectives on isolation
options.C: To explain why authors may choose isolation as a theme
options.D: To provide an example of isolation presented through a character's thoughts

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：演讲者为什么提到《白鲸记》？ 定位原文：Woman: Yet another example of isolation in literature, and one that ends badly, is Herman Melville's Moby Dick... propels him and his ship toward a destructive end. 选项分析： A. To illustrate how isolation can have tragic consequences in literature 说明孤立如何在文学中导致悲剧性后果。因为演讲者明确说这是一个“结局很糟”的例子，导致了毁灭性的结局，所以 A 选项正确。 B. To contrast different literary perspectives on isolation 对比关于孤立的不同文学观点。因为此处是为了举例说明孤立的负面后果，而非对比观点，所以 B 选项错误。 C. To explain why authors may choose isolation as a theme 解释为什么作者可能选择孤立作为主题。因为演讲是在展示孤立的表现，而非分析作者的选择动机，所以 C 选项错误。 D. To provide an example of isolation presented through a character's thoughts 提供一个通过人物思想展现孤立的例子。因为亚哈的孤立源于他的痴迷和复仇任务，导致了行动上的后果，而非仅仅是思想，所以 D 选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the speaker suggest about the character Jane Eyre?

options.A: Jane does not recognize that she has been isolated.
options.B: Jane manages to make friends at boarding school.
options.C: Jane has chosen to isolate herself.
options.D: Jane uses isolation to her advantage.

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：关于简·爱这个人物，演讲者暗示了什么？ 定位原文：Woman: But Jane is resilient in the face of isolation, becoming strong and independent. 选项分析： A. Jane does not recognize that she has been isolated. 简没有意识到自己被孤立了。因为演讲提到她经历了孤立，说明她是意识到的，所以 A 选项错误。 B. Jane manages to make friends at boarding school. 简在寄宿学校交到了朋友。因为演讲提到她在寄宿学校感到孤独，未提及交朋友，所以 B 选项错误。 C. Jane has chosen to isolate herself. 简选择孤立自己。因为演讲提到她是被送去亲戚家或在学校感到孤独，是被动的，而非主动选择，所以 C 选项错误。 D. Jane uses isolation to her advantage. 简利用孤立来为自己谋利（变强）。由于演讲者指出简在面对孤立时很有韧性，变得坚强和独立，这说明她将孤立的经历转化为了自身的优 势，所以 D 选项正确。
